text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout: runtime-engine v4.1.0-quant-shim -> canary @ 2026-03-20T23:00:21Z (regions: eu-west-1 then us-west2). Initial slice 10%. Auto-promote rules attached.

ash: Ack. Quick question — what's the rollback trigger if matmul failures appear?

viv: We defined: errors > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR KV-cache-miss spike > 5x baseline OR p95 increase > 20ms. Any other signals?

sandeep: Add GPU OOMs and eviction count > 10/min as immediate rollback.

oncall-ops: Heads up — 23:00 UTC overlaps with our nightly maintenance window in us-west2. Can we keep eu-west1 first and hold before us-west2 until manual ok? :eyes:

release-manager: Yes please hold on cross-region. We'll do eu-west1 canary, then manual go for us-west2 after 1h signoff. Also need a 2-line release note blurb.

ash: Suggestion for blurb: "runtime-engine v4.1.0 introduces an experimental quantization shim for kernel ABI compatibility. Can reduce token cost with minimal perf changes; canary rollout and automatic fallback enabled." Thoughts?

mike: LGTM but add short migration note: "If you rely on pinned kernels, set `engine.pin.version` in your config to keep old ABI until you opt in."

ash: Adding pin example:
```
engine:
  pin:
    version: "v4.0.9"
    ttl: "2h"
```
Use `deployctl pin` to apply cluster-wide.

ci-bot: Preflight smoke passed in staging (kv-cache, matmul sanity, latency): all green. Command run:
`./ci/scripts/preflight.sh --suite=quant-smoke --engine=v4.1.0`

viv: Control-plane note — add release note that ABI checksum changed; compatibility shim will map old KV keys. Ops teams should check `kv-cache-hit-rate` during canary.

sandeep: Pin strategy: on severe regression, deploybot will sticky-pin previous ABI for 2h automatic; human rollback required to revert permanent.

oncall-ops: I'll be ready for manual hold at +1h. Please ping `@oncall-ops` when promoting to us-west2.

release-manager: I'll draft the public release note and send to marketing. Anything else?

ash: One last ask — increase telemetry sampling for first 30m of canary to 100% for the key signals.

deploybot: Noted. Telemetry ramp set to 100% for 30m. Canary slice 10% -> hold -> manual promote. Rollback conditions applied. :robot_face:
